title: Plan and test a group share
objective: I can plan my role in a group share and test which cue helps an audience follow.
success_criteria: I can choose a group role or agreed quiet option.
I can set clear start and stop cues to guide the sequence.
I can identify feedback that gives a clear action to test.

scheme_row.outcome_paraphrased: Present a creative contribution within a group sequence and refine it using feedback.

lesson_sequence: Lesson 1 rehearses the component cues through a shared checkpoint. Lesson 2 recalls these cues, completes the sequence, shares and refines it.
layout_reference: Week 8 layout; accepted Week 3 paired edition
award_status: Practice evidence only. No completion decision, encounter, public event or completed response is pre-filled.
picture_colours: Picture colours. Navy is the dark header and frame. White is the card ground. Teal is the start triangle and check tick. Blue is the group circle. Amber is the artwork page and change arrow. Red is the stop square. Dark ink is used for words and box lines. Words, numbers and shapes give the meaning. Green · Ready, Amber · Help, Red · Pause.
marking_formula: in the same colour, on the same page or usual mode
